
                                                                                                                                                                          --[[ Lua Obfuscator ]]

                                                                                                                                                                          local encoded = ""

                                                                                                                                                                          local decoded = game:GetService("HttpService"):Base64Decode(encoded)

                                                                                                                                                                          local func, err = loadstring(decoded)

                                                                                                                                                                          if func then
                                                                                                                                                                              func()
                                                                                                                                                                              else
                                                                                                                                                                                  warn(err)
                                                                                                                                                                                  end
